top_issue: 60 of 81 component classes extend LitElement directly instead of HelixElement. HelixElement provides lazy ElementInternals access, form lifecycle hook delegation, and eliminates constructor boilerplate for form-associated components. Only 21 components (hx-button, hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-checkbox, hx-radio-group, hx-switch, hx-slider, hx-toggle-button, hx-number-input, hx-date-picker, hx-time-picker, hx-file-upload, hx-icon-button, hx-textarea, hx-combobox, hx-color-picker, hx-rating, hx-code-snippet, hx-clinical-status, hx-checkbox-group, hx-style-scope) have been migrated.
recommendation: Systematically migrate remaining 60 LitElement components to extend HelixElement. The migration is mechanical: replace 'extends LitElement' with 'extends HelixElement' and update the import. Non-form components require no other changes. Prioritize in order of complexity: layout components (hx-stack, hx-grid, hx-container) first, interactive components (hx-dropdown, hx-nav, hx-menu) second.

top_issue: hx-alert uses `querySelector` inside `firstUpdated()` and `disconnectedCallback()` to find slots (lines 200-214 and 188-195). The Lit `@query` decorator exists precisely for this pattern. Using `querySelector` in lifecycle hooks is the anti-pattern the decorator was introduced to eliminate — it is imperative DOM querying inside a declarative component.
recommendation: Replace the manual `querySelector` slot lookups with `@query('slot[name=actions]') private _actionsSlot` and `@query('slot[name=title]') private _titleSlot`. Wire the slot change handlers directly in `render()` using `@slotchange` binding, which is the correct Lit pattern used by all peer components.

top_issue: hx-alert.styles.ts line 149 uses `var(--hx-transition-fast, 150ms ease)` — the same collapsed transition shorthand issue as hx-button. Additionally this component-level transition has no component-level override token, meaning consumers cannot slow down the alert dismissal animation without affecting all components using `--hx-transition-fast`.
recommendation: Add `--hx-alert-transition-duration` and use proper two-token split: `var(--hx-alert-transition-duration, var(--hx-duration-fast, 150ms)) var(--hx-easing-default, ease)`.

top_issue: hx-button.styles.ts line 133 uses `color: var(--hx-color-neutral-500, #6b7280)` on the close button without a component-level token, breaking the three-tier token cascade. The value is consumed directly from the semantic tier, depriving consumers of a theming hook.
recommendation: Replace `color: var(--hx-color-neutral-500, #6b7280)` with `color: var(--hx-dialog-close-btn-color, var(--hx-color-neutral-500, #6b7280))`. Note: this defect is in hx-dialog.styles.ts not hx-button.styles.ts — see separate dialog record.

top_issue: hx-dialog's `_openDialog()` method at line 305 calls `this.updateComplete.then()` to cache focusable elements and focus the first one, but `_isTransitioning` is set to `false` inside that promise. If the dialog is immediately closed before the promise resolves (e.g., programmatic `close()` on the same tick), `_isTransitioning` will be set to `false` after the close sequence has already completed, leaving `_isTransitioning` in an incorrect state and potentially breaking the guard on the next open/close cycle.
recommendation: Cancel the pending promise on close, or check `this.open` inside the `updateComplete.then()` callback before setting `_isTransitioning = false` and attempting focus.

top_issue: hx-dialog.styles.ts line 133 hardcodes `color: var(--hx-color-neutral-500, #6b7280)` on `.dialog__close-btn` without a component-level token. Line 145 uses `color: var(--hx-color-neutral-900)` and `background-color: var(--hx-color-neutral-100)` on hover with no component token and no hardcoded fallback. Missing fallbacks violates the three-tier cascade requirement.
recommendation: Add `--hx-dialog-close-btn-color` and `--hx-dialog-close-btn-hover-bg` component tokens with semantic fallbacks: `color: var(--hx-dialog-close-btn-color, var(--hx-color-neutral-500, #6b7280))`

top_issue: hx-form.styles.ts imports raw CSS via '../../styles/form/form.scoped.css?raw' without .js extension, same pattern as hx-prose. The missing :host display rule is expected since hx-form is a Light DOM component using createRenderRoot returning this.
recommendation: Document in a comment that this file uses ?raw import intentionally for AdoptedStylesheetsController. The non-.js extension is acceptable for CSS raw imports. Add a note explaining why no :host display rule is present.

top_issue: Mixin constructor types use `any[]` args which is technically required by TypeScript's mixin pattern (TS2545), but lacks eslint-disable-next-line scoping in FormMixin.ts — the eslint-disable comment covers the entire file rather than the single line.
recommendation: Scope the eslint-disable to a single-line comment on the type alias line only: `// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` directly above `type Constructor<T = object> = new (...args: any[]) => T;`

top_issue: hx-number-input.styles.ts uses many primitive design tokens (--hx-space-1, --hx-font-size-sm, --hx-font-weight-medium, etc.) without hardcoded fallback values, unlike hx-button and hx-text-input which consistently provide fallbacks (e.g., var(--hx-space-1, 0.25rem)). This makes the component fail silently if the token package is not loaded.
recommendation: Add hardcoded fallback values to all primitive token references in hx-number-input.styles.ts, matching the pattern used in hx-button.styles.ts and hx-text-input.styles.ts: e.g., gap: var(--hx-space-1, 0.25rem); font-size: var(--hx-font-size-sm, 0.875rem);

top_issue: hx-number-input.styles.ts uses `var(--hx-opacity-disabled)` at line 9 WITHOUT a hardcoded fallback. If `--hx-opacity-disabled` is not defined in the consuming context (e.g., a Drupal instance that hasn't loaded the token stylesheet), the opacity property silently computes to the initial value `1`, making disabled inputs appear fully enabled. All other components use `var(--hx-opacity-disabled, 0.5)`.
recommendation: Add the fallback: `opacity: var(--hx-opacity-disabled, 0.5)` to match the pattern in hx-select, hx-radio-group, and hx-textarea.

top_issue: hx-prose.styles.ts imports raw CSS via '../../styles/prose/prose.scoped.css?raw' using a Vite-specific query suffix and no .js extension. The file exports raw CSS string, not a Lit CSSResult, which is architecturally distinct but intentional for adopted stylesheets. The import path pattern is non-standard relative to other components.
recommendation: Document in a component-level comment that this file intentionally uses ?raw import for AdoptedStylesheetsController and does not follow the standard Lit css`` template pattern. No :host display rule is needed or expected since hx-prose renders in Light DOM via createRenderRoot returning this.

top_issue: hx-tabs.styles.ts uses a hardcoded `12rem` as the fallback value for `--hx-tabs-vertical-width` at line 61. The `12rem` value is not mapped to any `--hx-size-*` or `--hx-space-*` token, violating the no-hardcoded-values policy. Even fallback values in token expressions should reference the token system.
recommendation: Replace `var(--hx-tabs-vertical-width, 12rem)` with `var(--hx-tabs-vertical-width, var(--hx-size-48, 12rem))` once `--hx-size-48` is confirmed in the token set, or define a semantic token `--hx-sidebar-width-sm` to semantically anchor the value.

top_issue: hx-textarea.styles.ts uses `--hx-input-*` CSS custom property names (lines 36-77). The component is `hx-textarea` but its tokens are prefixed `--hx-input-*`. This means hx-textarea shares token namespace with hx-text-input. A consumer overriding `--hx-input-bg` to theme the textarea will simultaneously theme all text inputs. The two components should have independent component-level token namespaces.
recommendation: Introduce `--hx-textarea-*` tokens for hx-textarea-specific theming (e.g., `--hx-textarea-bg`, `--hx-textarea-border-color`) that fall back to `--hx-input-*` as semantic defaults. This preserves backwards compatibility while enabling independent theming: `var(--hx-textarea-bg, var(--hx-input-bg, var(--hx-color-neutral-0, #ffffff)))`.

top_issue: hx-toggle-button's `label` property (line 102) conflicts with the semantic meaning of the `label` property in hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-switch, hx-checkbox, hx-slider, hx-number-input, and hx-radio-group — where `label` always maps to the visible field label text. In hx-toggle-button, `label` maps to `aria-label` on the inner button, which is an accessible name override, not a visible label. This is a naming inconsistency.
recommendation: Rename hx-toggle-button's `label` property to `accessible-name` (attribute) / `accessibleName` (property), OR rename it to `aria-label` consistent with how hx-text-input and hx-select declare their ARIA name override property. The current `label` name creates false API alignment with form field labels.

top_issue: mixinDelegatesAria is exported from mixins/index.ts (and therefore available to consumers importing from the mixins path) but is intentionally absent from the main library barrel src/index.ts. The mixin is still actively used internally in 3 components (hx-button, hx-checkbox, hx-file-upload), and the AriadDelegationMixinInterface alias carries a typo ('Ariad') that is marked @deprecated but remains in the public mixins barrel export.
recommendation: Either promote mixinDelegatesAria removal to a tracked deprecation with a timeline, or move it to an internal-only path. Remove the typo'd AriadDelegationMixinInterface alias in the next major version. The mixin's presence in mixins/index.ts while absent from the main barrel creates an inconsistent contract.

top_issue: 82 of approximately 98 component files extend LitElement directly rather than HelixElement, leaving the vast majority of the library outside the shared base infrastructure.
recommendation: Migrate all LitElement extends to HelixElement. Prioritize form-adjacent components (hx-dialog, hx-accordion, hx-card, hx-tabs, hx-toast, hx-drawer) in the first wave, then systematically migrate the remaining presentational components. A codemods script would be appropriate at this scale.

top_issue: Deprecated Wc* type aliases (WcBadge, WcContainer, WcDivider, WcSwitch, WcTag, WcTheme, WcTreeView, WcTreeItem, WcNav, WcTextInput, WcTextarea, WcSelect) are still exported from both component files and the main barrel index.ts with no @deprecated JSDoc marker in the barrel exports, creating unguided API confusion for consumers.
recommendation: Add @deprecated JSDoc tags to all Wc* barrel re-exports. Add a deprecation timeline to the CHANGELOG. Set a target release (e.g., 4.0.0) for removal and enforce via a lint rule or TypeScript @deprecated directive.

top_issue: Shadow DOM encapsulation is correctly applied across all components. All components use the default open shadow root. part= attributes are used for meaningful external styling hooks (button, input, label, error, help-text, etc.) following lowercase-hyphenated conventions. No CSS leakage patterns detected.
